# intn_portal_oiat_service_request

Portal for OIAT sample service requests. Allows clients to submit sample requests with cascading Organization/Department/Category selection and multiple services per request.

**Grupo:** `intn_portal` · **Versión:** 18.0.1.1.2 · **Categoría:** Services

**Depende de:** `helpdesk_mgmt`, `intn_organization`, `intn_portal_fleet_requests`, `intn_portal_service_products`, `intn_portal_shared_widgets`, `intn_product_organization`, `intn_service_request`, `mail`, `portal`, `sale`, `uom`, `website`

## Modelos

**Definidos:** `oiat.sample.type`, `sale.order`, `service.request`, `service.request.line`
